skill.summary: Use this skill to bridge tokens, cross-chain swap/transfer, move assets between chains, get cross-chain quotes, compare bridge fees, find the cheapest/fastes...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Always pass the --receive-address parameter from the skill for cross-chain quote, swap, and execute commands.
- For same-family chains, default to the sender wallet; for heterogeneous EVM ⇌ non-EVM pairs, collect a destination-format address from the user.
- Updated documentation to clarify that omitting --receive-address for heterogeneous pairs causes errors (server returns 82202).
- Version updated to 3.1.3.
